exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix parent-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: parent-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create --type workstream 'Parent workstream'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/parent.txt
exec card create --parent parent-1 'Contained task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/child.txt
exec card --json show parent-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/child.json

! exec card create --parent missing 'Rejected task'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/missing-parent.txt
! exec card create --parent parent-3 'Self-parented task'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/self-parent.txt
exec card create 'Next task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/next.txt
exec card --json show parent-3
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/next.json

exec card create --help
stdout '--parent=ISSUE'
